messages:
maria_sales: Hey @ashley_csm — handing off Sunrise Health pilot (pilot id: SUN-PLT-042). Two-week pilot starting Mon. Key asks: SSO + VPC connectivity, dedicated capacity for ~40 qps, and evaluation of embedding cost for patient-note search. Primary contact: claire@sunrise.health. Renewal signal: high if latency < 120ms and embedding cost < $0.0005/token.
ashley_csm: Thanks — quick clarifying q's: who owns infra onboarding vs integrations? and any known infra constraints?
maria_sales: infra owned by devon_eng for provisioning; integrations (SSO + data mapping) owned by CS, I'll support discovery call. They want a warm handover call Tue 10am PT.
devon_eng: noted. infra constraints: their VPC requires static egress IPs and we need to run dedicated pool in us-west-2. KV cache prewarm recommended — first-hour latency spike expected. I opened infra ticket INF-8342 for dedicated pool + static IPs.
jordan_support: adding support context — rotation assigned to @jordan_support and @lee_support. We'll be oncall for pilot hours (Mon-Fri 9-5 PT). Please add runbook link.
maria_sales: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sunrise-pilot (internal). Also shared the signed security questionnaire in the Drive.
ashley_csm: Action items I have so far: 1) schedule Tue handover (owner: maria_sales) 2) CS onboarding plan draft (owner: ashley_csm) 3) infra ticket INF-8342 follow-up (owner: devon_eng) 4) SSO test window + SAML metadata exchange (owner: claire@sunrise.health / ashley_csm). Anyone want to add SLA/renewal notes?
devon_eng: INF-8342 ETA: provisioned by Thu EOD if VPC peering approved. Note: quantization profile will be q4_8 to hit cost target; impacts accuracy slightly — please capture eval prompts.
ashley_csm: I'll run a quick eval suite against q4_8 before the pilot to flag regressions. Need list of 10 priority prompts from the customer — @maria_sales can you get that?
maria_sales: pinged claire, she said will share priority prompts by Mon morning.
jordan_support: Support prep: created ticket SUP-5583 with Slack channel #sunrise-support (private) and monitoring hooks. Add alerts: token rate > 60/min and avg latency > 150ms.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Dedicated pool provision request INF-8342 moved to in-progress by devon_eng.
ashley_csm: Risk register note: renewal flag = medium-high. Technical risks: VPC connection time, KV cache warmup, small accuracy delta on quantized model. Operational risks: onboarding timeline slip (we need to hit 10-day activation).
maria_sales: Renewal discussions paused until pilot metrics, but sales asked us to focus on embedding unit economics. Please capture cost per convo metric and put in weekly sync.
ashley_csm: Weekly sync scheduled Fri 11am PT, invite sent to claire + internal owners. I'll create a shared doc for feedback capture and regression tracking: https://redwood.internal/ops/sunrise-feedback.
devon_eng: FYI, for prewarming you can run: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm -d '{"model":"embed-4-small","qps":40}'`` — that'll populate KV cache and cut tail latency. Use with care.
jordan_support: Noted. I'll add warmup steps to runbook and include a health-check script.
maria_sales: final ask: can CS/Support confirm handoff owners and immediate next steps here?
ashley_csm: Owners confirmed: CS onboarding = ashley_csm; infra provisioning = devon_eng; support rotations = jordan_support & lee_support; sales handoff follow-ups = maria_sales. Next steps: 1) maria to confirm priority prompts by Mon 9am PT, 2) devon to update INF-8342 by Wed with IPs, 3) ashley to publish onboarding plan by Wed EOD, 4) jordan to post runbook updates and health-checks.
jordan_support: Confirmed. I'll also add alert thresholds to PagerDuty and set a daily 9:30am monitor check during pilot start week.
maria_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll host Tue 10am handover. Claire + their infra lead invited. :thumbsup:
ashley_csm: Thanks — I'll prep eval harness and feedback doc. See you Tue. :raised_hands:
